_meta.note: Spoon-fed WhatsApp reply pack. The FSM in guided_flow.py looks these up FIRST. Gemini is only used when a reply_id is missing and the state has no catch-all. Placeholders: {name} {who} {event} {occasion} {special_request} {slot} {dishes} {phone} {email} {hours} {company} {established}. Never use em-dashes.

redeploy.before_replace: Copy live files into /home/ubuntu/srivatsanka-backups/<timestamp>/ then overlay new code. Never rm the live database, .env, or uploads. Overlay website/dist only after the current dist is copied into that backup folder.
